title: Empty WR-90 periodic along z (period 10 mm): the Bloch bands at ψ = 0°, 90°, 180°
source: Modes of a rectangular guide with a phase ψ per period L: k² = (mπ/a)² + (nπ/b)² + ((ψ + 2πq)/L)² (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., §3.3; R. E. Collin, Foundations for Microwave Engineering, 2nd ed., periodic structures), evaluated by an independent script

quantities.reason: second-order elements of 3 mm: measured 2e-6 (the field is uniform along z, sin(πx/a) across)
TE20 varies twice as fast across the guide: measured +2.8e-5

quantities.quantity: band 1 at ψ = 90°: TE10 with β = π/2L (GHz)
quantities.reason: the Floquet phase e^{−jψ} complex, the Hermitian problem solved by LU: measured +2.6e-5

quantities.quantity: band 1 at ψ = 180°: TE10 at the zone's edge (GHz)
quantities.reason: β = π/L, about three elements per half wavelength along z: measured +9.6e-5

quantities.quantity: band 2 at ψ = 180°: TE10's backward harmonic, degenerate with band 1 (GHz)
quantities.reason: the degenerate pair at the zone's edge, found as two vectors of the Hermitian Ritz problem
